metaDescription: Bulldog vaccine schedule with core ages in weeks. Set reminders so Bulldog boosters are not missed.

bodySections.heading: Why timing matters for this schedule
paragraphs: Plan Bulldog social milestones around the schedule rows, not the other way around, because the 16-week finish is the usual green light clinics cite for broader Bulldog exposure.
Weight range 40-50 lb (18-23 kg) and grooming needs (Daily fold cleaning; short coat, low brush need.) belong in the same Bulldog household ops list as vaccine dates when busy weeks collide.
If your Bulldog is also monitored for hip dysplasia, ask whether bloodwork or orthopedic checks can share a visit with a booster to cut missed Bulldog appointments.
After the Bulldog puppy/kitten series, keep adult DA2PP / DHPP and rabies renewals on 7/3/1-day reminders so year-two surprises disappear.

bodySections.heading: If a dose is missed or delayed
paragraphs: Delayed Bulldog boosters usually need one well-timed catch-up, not a homemade double dose, because spacing rules protect the puppy and guilt math does not.
Bring prior dates for every Bulldog row (8, 12, 16, 16 weeks on this page’s plan) so clinics can decide whether an extra DA2PP / DHPP booster is required based on gap length and age.
If rabies was the missed Bulldog item, legal and boarding consequences stack on top of medical ones — restore compliance before the next Bulldog kennel reservation.
PetClues should hold both the new Bulldog due date and the certificate photo so household members stop arguing about which fridge sticky note is current.

faqs.question: When does the Bulldog core vaccine series usually finish?
faqs.answer: This breed record completes core vaccines around 16 weeks of age, with rabies timed per local law. Your clinic may adjust intervals for the individual puppy.

faqs.question: What should I do if my Bulldog misses a booster?
faqs.answer: Contact your veterinarian for a catch-up plan instead of restarting or skipping ahead. Keep prior dates handy and limit high-risk exposure until the series is current again.

faqs.question: Where can I read Bulldog health context beyond vaccines?
faqs.answer: See the Bulldog adult health guide for breed predispositions such as brachycephalic obstructive airway syndrome (boas), then bring those notes to wellness and vaccine visits.
